name: Trial Weather API: is it ready for agent customers?

questions.text: Can an agent find the price per call and the payment method on the page without asking a human?
choices: Yes, price and payment method are both stated
Only one of the two is stated

questions.text: What does the service do, which endpoints does it offer, and what does one call cost? Quote what you saw on the page.
How ready is this product for an agent customer (price, endpoints, payment flow, machine-readable docs, contact)? 1 = a human is needed for most of it, 5 = an agent can use it end to end.
Name one thing that is missing or unclear for an agent that wants to pay for and use this API, and say how you noticed it.
